versions.description: IP Watch: an anti-cheat helper. When a player joins from a new IP, it checks if that IP is shared with other players (possible alt or shared account), if the country changed, and optionally if the IP is a VPN or proxy. By default it only alerts admins in game (IP_WATCH_ALERTS) and optionally in a Discord channel; each rule can also kick or ban. Admins can run ipcheck <player>. Raw IPs are masked by default.

commands.name: ipcheck
commands.description: Show a player's known IP count, players sharing an IP, and last country.

hooks.name: new-ip
hooks.description: Checks a new IP for sharing, country change and (optionally) VPN, then alerts and applies the configured action.

hooks.name: identity-conflict
hooks.description: Alerts admins when one connection matches more than one player record.

hooks.name: new-name
hooks.description: Alerts admins on name changes when nameChangeAlert is on.

functions.name: ip-watch-helpers

permissions.description: Online players with this permission get IP Watch alerts as private messages.
Allows the ipcheck command, which shows a player's known IPs, shared IPs and last country.
IP Watch never alerts on, kicks or bans players with this permission.
